vvb_guidance.governing_prior_period_doc: VVB Guidance July 1 - July 31 (id 1IQS3Aeqg3MISVjXqzRtYcYmCvEfRo7LNxQgilqdlF0U, owner garrett.lutz@) — read in full. Section 'Kerry Calciner Oil — Bulk Tanker Delivery and Kerry-Specific Solids Content' establishes the ongoing methodology (no restatement needed in August since unchanged): quote below.
vvb_guidance.kerry_section_verbatim: Delivery form. In this Reporting Period, Kerry calciner oil is delivered to the Basco injection site in bulk tanker trailers rather than in IBC totes as in prior Periods. Delivered mass is therefore established from CAT Scale tickets — the full weight less the post-offload empty (tare) weight of the same tractor and trailer — rather than from per-tote tag weights. There is no per-tote record for a tanker load; the scale tickets are the primary mass evidence. Filtered mass — Kerry-specific solids content. Kerry oil passes through the same 25 µm wellhead filter as Charm's other injected oil, and the solids retained by that filter are subtracted from the delivered mass to arrive at the mass of bio-oil injected. For Kerry, that subtraction uses the measured solids content of Kerry calciner oil itself, not the AECN-derived solids content that Charm applies to its other third-party oil. ... Loss treatment. Kerry takes a filtration deduction only. No sparging loss is applied to Kerry oil (because Kerry is not sparged), and the deduction appears in the Filtration column — not the Sparging column — of the weekly ops-notes summary. pH tracking. ... we do not have an independent pH value that is specific to Kerry. Rather, the pH measured over the course of the month's AECN injections is net of Kerry oil as well.
vvb_guidance.flagged_inconsistency: July VVB Guidance states Kerry solids are 'materially higher' than AECN's, but the actual constant applied this period (Ops Notes Kerry tab cell O5 = 0.071%) is LOWER than AECN's Filtration Solids Content constant (0.195%, AECN Rail tab). Immaterial to Net CO2e (~7.77 kg on a 10,949.71 kg load, <0.08%) but a documentation-consistency gap worth flagging to Garrett.
